text_en: I can't believe we're finally doing this!
You can't keep a sea wolf on land for too long!
I can't wait to see where this adventure takes us!
Boy, did I miss this boat!
This reminds me of the good old times...
I'm so happy to be sailing again! Big adventure, here we come!
I remember the first time I set foot on this deck...
A cruise around the world, anyone?
This reminds me of "The Old Man and The Sea." But hey, I'm not that old now, am I?
Off to the unexplored seas, my friends!
